title: Tile Is Moving to Life360: How to Move Your Tiles | Life360
summary: The Tile app is going away. Learn why your Tile app isn't working, how to move your Tiles to Life360 for free in minutes, and what changes.
body_markdown:
## **Summary**


**What this article covers:**


Why the Tile app is going away over the coming months, what to do if your Tile app isn't working, how to move your Tiles to Life360 for free, and what changes (and what doesn't) once you do.


### **Who it's for**


-


Tile owners with Tiles on their keys, bags, wallets, or other personal belongings


-


Anyone whose Tile app isn't working the way it used to


-


Tile owners who already have a Life360 account


-


Tile Premium subscribers wondering what happens next


### **Key Takeaways**


-


The Tile app is going away, and the Life360 app is the new home for your Tiles.


-


Moving is free, takes a few minutes, and brings every Tile over at once, no need to re-add one by one.


-


You can use Life360 only for your Tiles. If that's all you use it for, location sharing is off by default.


-


Tiles from 2019 and later work in Life360.


-


You will receive an email when your experience is ready. If you have not received an email or see an in-app message, you can continue to use the Tile app until you do.


You've got a Tile on your keys, another in your bag, and maybe one on the TV remote that's been playing hide and seek since move-in day. Then an email landed saying that the Tile app is going away. Take a breath. Your Tiles aren't going anywhere. Tile is joining the Life360 app, and getting your Tiles there takes just a few minutes.


Here's everything you need to know, including how to move your Tiles, and what you get when you do.


## **Why Is the Tile App Going Away?**


Because keeping track of the people, pets, and things you care about most shouldn't take a pile of apps. Life360 and Tile are now one team, so we're officially bringing Tile users into the Life360 app. You get the same find-it-and-ring-it experience you already know, plus new free features.


The Tile app is going away and once it's gone, using Tiles on the Tile app won't be supported so you’ll need to download and use the Life360 app for free. We want every member, Tile owners included, to get better experiences over time, and one app makes that happen.


## **Why Isn't My Tile App Working?**


If your Tile app isn't working the way it used to, the reason is simple: it's going away. Your Tiles are fine. Moving them to Life360 is how you keep finding your stuff. Here's where to start:


-


**Check your inbox (and spam).** If you've been invited, the email from Tile has a link that moves all your Tiles to Life360 in one go.


-


**Know that the Tile app won't be supported once it's gone.** Moving to Life360 is how you keep finding your things.


-


**Some older Tiles may not work after migration.** If your Tile does not work after migration, please[chat with us](https://support.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/30583079611671-Contact-Us) .


-


**Still not seeing your Tiles?** Please[chat with us](https://support.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/30583079611671-Contact-Us?_gl=1*4e7wki*__gcl_au*MTAzODI4MTA5Ny4xNzg4MjkyMTEw*FPAU*MTU0NDE0ODcxMy4xNzg4MjkyMTEx) and we’ll get you sorted.


## **What You Get in Life360**


Everything you love about Tile still works. Find your things, and ring them when you're nearby. Then it gets better, with free extras:


-


**48-hour location history,** so you can retrace your steps


-


**Built-in Life360 SOS,** send an alert to your entire Circle with the press of a button


-


**The option to add people and pets,** so everyone and everything you care about lives in one app


### **Want Just Your Tiles? You Can Do That**


Life360 has a Tile-only experience built around your Tiles. If that's all you use it for, location sharing, Personalized Ads, and Traffic & Retail Insights are off by default. If you add family or friends later, you can create a Circle and turn sharing on.


## **How to Move Your Tiles to Life360**


To move your Tiles, open your invitation, create a free Life360 account with the same email as your Tile account, and move all your Tiles at once.


-


**Open your invitation.** Tap the link in your email, or the message in the Tile app.


-


**Create your free Life360 account.** Use the same email as your Tile account so everything comes with you.


-


**Move your Tiles.** All of them, at once. No re-adding one by one.


-


**Open Life360.** Your Tiles are right there, ready to ring.


### **Already Have a Life360 Account?**


On an iPhone, download the latest version of the Life360 app, then open the link from your email on the phone where you’re logged into Life360. Tap the gear icon at the top left, find the option to link your Tile account, and follow the steps. This works whether your Tile account uses the same email address as your Life360 account or a different one.


On Android, the fix won’t be available until 11/24, follow these steps then.


Already have Tiles in your Life360 account? Read this[Help Center article](https://support.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/23053717327255-Life360-and-Tile) to ensure a smooth merge.


### **Troubleshooting the Move**


**Can't find the link to my Tile account option?** Turn off Wi-Fi, make sure your VPN is off, close the Life360 app, then click the link in your email again.


**Seeing an error that your Tile account is already linked to a Life360 account?** Contact Life360 customer care and we'll help you sort it out.


## **What Does It Cost?**


Nothing. A Life360 account is free, and so is moving your Tiles.


Pay for Tile Premium? Your subscription isn't changing right now. We're starting with free members, and we'll share details for Premium subscribers once that experience is ready.


## **Your Data, Your Call**


Life360 is built on consent and choice. You decide how you participate, what you share, and which features you use. See how your data is used, and change it anytime, in **Settings > Privacy Center** . For more information, visit[life360.com/trust-safety](https://www.life360.com/trust-safety) .


## **Final Recommendations**


When your invitation arrives, open it and move your Tiles right away. It's free, it takes a few minutes, and every Tile comes over at once.


If you have a Life360 account without any Tiles and a Tile account already, if you are using an iPhone, make sure you have the latest version from the App Store, then open the Life360 app, go to settings (left gear), and click ‘Link my Tiles’.


If you have an Android the fix will be available 11/24, follow these steps then.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **Is the Tile app going away?**


Yes. Tile is moving into the Life360 app, and the Tile app will no longer be around. Once it's gone, it won't be supported, so moving your Tiles to Life360 is how you keep finding and ringing them. We're inviting Tile owners in stages, and you'll get a link by email when it's your turn.


### **How do I move my Tiles to Life360?**


Open the link from your invitation email or in the Tile app, create a free Life360 account with the same email as your Tile account, and move your Tiles. All of them transfer at once, with no re-adding them one by one, and the whole process takes just a few minutes.


### **Will my Tiles still work after I move?**


Yes. You can still track your devices and ring them when you're nearby. Tiles from 2019 and later work in Life360, and so do most partner devices. If your Tile is older than 2019 and doesn’t work after migration, please[chat with us](https://support.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/30583079611671-Contact-Us)


### **Do I need to pay for Life360 to use my Tiles?**


No. You can create a free Life360 account with no subscription required and move your Tiles at no cost.


### **Do I have to share my location with anyone?**


No. You can use Life360 just for your Tiles, and location sharing stays off by default. If you add family or friends later, you can create a Circle and turn sharing on, and you can change it anytime in Settings.


### **What happens to my Tile Premium subscription?**


Your Tile Premium subscription isn't changing right now. We're starting with free members and will share details for Premium subscribers once that experience is ready.


### **I already have a Life360 account, but I do not have my Tiles linked in my Life360 account. What do I do?**


On an iPhone, update your Life360 app to the latest version, tap the gear at the top left, and choose the link to my Tile account. This works whether your Tile account uses the same email as your Life360 account or a different one.


If you have an Android the fix won’t be available until 11/24, follow these steps then.


### **I already have a Life360 account with Tiles, and a Tile account with a different email address with different Tiles. What do I do?**


In this scenario, please[link the accounts](https://support.life360.com/hc/en-us/articles/23053717327255-Life360-and-Tile) .
